notes.title: Are you ready to rise from the ashes?
notes.content:
[h1]MANTRA UPDATE
[/h1]
[b]Mantra[/b] update brings new content and bug fixes to the game.

[list]
[*] Reworked and improved game mechanics.

[*] Fixed issues with item crafting mechanics.

[*] Fixed and improved issues with the demon AI.

[*] Fixed lobby connectivity and game kicking issues.

[*] Map lighting optimized.

[*] Optimized connection problems in the game.

[*] Fixed the issue of items disappearing during the ritual.

[*] Fixed issue with items not disappearing and game not ending during last rite.

[*] Many fixes and minor bugs have been resolved.
[/list]

[h1]FULL RELEASE INFORMATION [/h1]

Our team continues to work to bring [b]Mantra[/b] to full release. We will soon satisfy your curiosity by providing more information about our work. [b]Stay tuned...[/b] 

[url=https://discord.gg/puDNjmKFWR]MANTRA DİSCORD SERVER[/url]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE; VERSION 0.110
notes.content:
Our game has been updated to version 0.110 Update content;
-A short training section has been added to the beginning of the game explaining how it is played.
-Ritual bugs are fixed.
-Item spawn locations and quantities have been increased.
-Fixed bugs during demon attack.
-New duty added.
-Some minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: October 25 update notes
notes.content:
A character walk was fixed.
The artificial intelligence of the beast has been improved.
New sounds added.
Some minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: First bug update
notes.content:
Multiplayer connection problems fixed.
Door and item spawn problems fixed.
Brightness settings added and ambient lighting made better.
And other minor bugs fixed.
